title: isoetes echinospora var. braunii
intro: Isoetes echinospora var. braunii, commonly known as Braun's quillwort, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the quillwort family (Isoetaceae). It is primarily found in North America, where it inhabits shaded, slow-moving streams and rivers. Braun's quillwort has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and antimicrobial effects.
